What version of Thunderbird and Android are you running?

  • If your not running the lastest app version (v21.1), please upgrade.

A number of issues with symptoms similar to your own were fixed in previous updates. For example v18 included a fix for: Crash occurred when retrieving images from large messages (#10721)

  • Are you able to provide more detail about the issue?

For example, does the issue occur on every email you open.

  • Try reinstalled the app and keep default settings as a troubleshooting step?

If your unable to resolve the issue, please log a bug report on github and attach a debug log. https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-android/issues

A guide to collecting a debug log is found here.
